title: On noncommutative Hom-anti-pre-Poisson superalgebras and related structures
summary: In this paper, we develop the theory of several Hom-type anti-algebraic structures in the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded setting. We introduce and study Hom-anti-associative superalgebras, Hom-anti-dendriform superalgebras, and Hom-anti-pre-Lie superalgebras, which arise as Hom-type generalizations of the corresponding anti-algebraic structures. Various constructions and examples are provided, together with structural properties and representation-theoretic aspects.
